# Test fixtures

**These are SYNTHETIC.** They are hand-written samples of the *output shape* of
`v4l2-ctl`, used to test parsers. They are not measurements of the Insta360
Connect and must never be copied into `HARDWARE.md` — see CLAUDE.md #5.

Once a real probe has run on the Pi, add the genuine output here as additional
fixtures (named `real-*`) so the parsers are tested against what the hardware
actually emits.
